name: io.github.sepehr071/fidibo-mcp
title: Fidibo
description: Unofficial read-only Fidibo: search Persian ebooks and audiobooks, compare prices, free books.

environmentVariables.name: FIDIBO_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for every request, or a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next. System proxy settings are ignored.
